title: GEMglRasterPos3dv
description: specify the raster position for pixel operations

messages.description: list of the raster position's 3 coordinates (x, y and z)

arguments.description: x coordinate of the raster position
y coordinate of the raster position
z coordinate of the raster position

body: [GEMglRasterPos3dv] calls glRasterPos3dv() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glRasterPos in the OpenGL reference.
